author: Monochromal
body:
Hi, 

I would like to be unbanned since I wasn't breaking any rules; I especially wasn't using "NoSlowDown" hacks or any hacks at all. The moderator that banned me was Acceqted and I definitely think this is an error.

Thank you.

replies.author: Monochromal
replies.body:
That must've been lag on the bow part because I literally never used hacks before, I didn't even know what No Slow Down was so I had to look it up lmao 

Absolutely incredible, I play on a server for a long time only to get lagged and make it seem like I'm hacking. 
I don't even have words at the moment, I've been falsely accused of hacking multiple times, one of them being on this server and somehow now it seems like I was. It's quite upsetting really, I simply don't understand how that's possible.

replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
Hello,

After going through the evidence, I can honestly say it's insufficient and inconclusive. This is a widely known visual glitch which happens to users, and which as also usually mistaken for no-slowdown. I will appeal your infraction, my apologies for all inconvenience caused.
